issue.body:
- [x] I'm sure this does not appear in [the issue list of the repository](https://github.com/arco-design/arco-design-vue/issues)

## Basic Info 
- **Package Name And Version:** @arco-design/web-vue@2.36.0
- **Framework version:** 3.2.38
- **Browser:** chrome105.0.0.0
- **Reproduction Link:** https://codesandbox.io/s/async-shadow-71fjcm?file=/src/App.vue

## Extra info
1. 该bug目前仅在vue 3.2.38出现，3.2.38 有对watch进行bugfix，详见：https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
2. 除了数据问题，Message样式在3.2.38也有些问题
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46062895/188348996-8e1e632f-7def-42cd-aa53-a2432fce9c9c.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46062895/188350040-e9bad73a-8222-458c-899e-266512360c16.png)



## What is expected?
按钮在数据更新后变更样式，但是因为watch中Message的加入，在前几次点击按钮更新数据时，数据更新的很奇怪，多次连续出现true，导致按钮的样式也不能正确变化
如果将watch中的Message.xxx移除，则页面更新正常

## Steps to reproduce
1. 创建一个`ref<boolean>`
4. 写一个按钮样式依赖这个`ref<boolean>`
   比如`<a-button  :type="refName ? 'primary' : 'outline'">按钮</a-button>`
5. 给按钮一个点击事件，把这个ref的值取反
6. watch这个ref，并在发生变化时调用Message.info/success/...

@yyx990803 I can still reproduce the issue on a deployed app (Vue 3.2.39 in production mode) but it's very difficult to create a reproduction as it seems to be random. I guess there is a timing or race condition at play...

Here is a screenshot of requests failing becase watchers are being executed while unmounting components after changing route:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2798204/192817556-dcfa08f0-763f-4b93-aef9-eadbfc7e463f.png)

I will continue to investigate and try to narrow the issue down.
